name: Stretch Break
summary: A guided stretch break for your back and posture after a day at the computer, plus a lymph tapping routine: a voice talks you through each move while an example person does it with you, and iPhone saves it to Apple Health.

screenshots.alt: Stretch Break page with an example person leaning into a side stretch, a 14 second countdown, the spoken cue, and the next step

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Stretch Break
config.description: A guided, spoken stretch routine for your back and posture, and a lymph tapping routine, with an example person to follow.

permissions.label: Read your own stretch sessions and settings, encrypted under your account's own key
Log and delete stretch sessions and change your voice and routine settings
On iPhone, with your permission, save each session to Apple Health as a workout and read this week's stretch workouts
Speak the cues in your device's own voice; nothing is sent to a speech service
